احتملتا (form VIII)
# اِحْتَمَلَتَا (iḥtamalatā) /iħ.ta.ma.la.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِحْتَمَلَ (iḥtamala)
# اُحْتُمِلَتَا (uḥtumilatā) /uħ.tu.mi.la.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِحْتَمَلَ (iḥtamala)
